methodologyNotes: Covers residential kitchen range hoods (ducted or convertible/ductless) sold at a published US MSRP, including under-cabinet, wall-mount, island, insert, and downdraft styles. Excludes commercial/restaurant hoods, over-the-range microwaves with integrated venting (OTR combos), and standalone recirculating filter cartridges. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. mountType is an enum: under-cabinet, wall-mount, island, insert, or downdraft. widthInches is nominal hood width in inches. maxAirflowCfm is the manufacturer's rated maximum airflow at the highest fan speed in cubic feet per minute (CFM). fanSpeeds is the count of discrete blower speed settings (integer). maxNoiseSones is rated loudness at the highest speed in sones per the HVI convention (lower is quieter); null if not disclosed. ductDiameterInches is the round duct outlet diameter in inches for the standard ducted configuration (rectangular outlets converted to nearest round equivalent); null if ductless-only. convertibleDuctless is a boolean: true if the hood can be configured for recirculating/ductless operation with a charcoal filter. filterType is an enum for the primary grease filter: baffle, mesh, or charcoal. controlType is an enum for the primary user control: push-button, rotary, touch, or gesture. lightingType is an enum for the cooktop lamps: LED, halogen, or incandescent.
